calibration.controls: Two public Triplex runtimes, identical frozen fixtures/contracts, three alternating-order runs under the fair serialized profile. Native probes are diagnostics and replay is an oracle.
calibration.rule: Freeze numeric SLOs and source/control identities in a create-only calibration receipt before optimization candidate runs. A new scale gets fresh controls before candidates. Candidate failures cannot redefine baselines. Changed budgets/topology/semantics/formula create a new named profile and retain original failures.

samplingRules: No successful-only service percentiles; preserve timeout/error counts and raw observations.
Do not combine different query families, cold/warm states or concurrency levels into a latency population.
Small pilot samples remain diagnostic and never close a scale gate.
Two or three experiments may share the server for correctness; paired performance and process-failure trials run exclusively.
Observe active backend queries and waiting clients separately from sixteen submitted clients.
Never present XTDB8GiB versus QLever4GiB development runs as a fair performance comparison.
capacityRule: Before each stage, admit measured projected storage plus worst overlapping WAL, compaction, backup/restore and scratch under the fixed resource profile. Over-budget stages remain BLOCKED_CAPACITY and completion remains unachieved; no deletion or budget increase converts failure into a pass.
correctnessOracle: Independent immutable-event replay and frozen expected answers; not an engine competitor
duckdbPolicy: Read-only source/research/workload reference only; no cloning, dependency installation, execution or process changes
